purpose: Normalize near-duplicate semantic tags across governed source records for cross-period comparison while preserving named concepts as separate dimensions.
rules: Named concepts are never collapsed into generic semantic families.
微月光 is a named concept and is explicitly excluded from 光月意象.
Raw source tags remain evidence; normalized families are a comparison/display projection.
Source Scope retains authority over source semantics; normalization Features consume that Scope without taking ownership; temporal grouping is a separate Feature.
Historical LOC1–8 identifiers may be retained only as provenance and do not define Current ownership or Feature authority.

families.label: 光月意象
families.note: 泛指月亮、月光與一般光線視覺意象；「微光」若承擔希望語義，歸入「希望」；不包含專有名詞「微月光」。
